trigger: open_dir_no_follow("<dir>/lnk/") or the file form, where lnk is a symlink to a directory (also a chain); the caller's path ends in '/'. Probed on Darwin by two reporters: lnk -> ENOTDIR, lnk/ -> succeeds and the symlink is followed; Linux path resolution follows on a trailing slash too (likely, not run). The _at forms are safe (they reject '/').
classification_rationale: a false comment adjacent to a confinement branch: the header says the path forms do not follow the leaf, but a trailing '/' makes the kernel follow it (a truth finding, not wording). Reporters disagreed and the derived band governs: unhappy-path UP-1 said CRITICAL; security-guardian F2 said MEDIUM and then capped it at LOW because no production caller exists, which the skill does not accept as E6 (E6 needs the wrong outcome proven impossible, a missing caller does not).
summary: Derived HIGH, CRITICAL if E2 is accepted (E2 is contestable: the attacker controls the link, the caller controls the slash; HIGH is the floor of the range and either way it gates); severity_native MEDIUM is security-guardian's own word. Architect adopted: both path forms now reject a path ending in '/' or '/.' with EINVAL before any syscall ('/' alone stays allowed), header contract updated, test added with a mutation note. Fixed in c74919b25. Gate 8 confirmed the guard closes it and found no remaining trailing-component bypass (removing the '/' check fails 8 assertions, the '/.' check 8, the whole guard 20).

trigger: a future consumer forwards a NUL-bearing std::string to the path forms (nlohmann keeps \u0000 in info_cache keys, so a Local State profile_dir can carry one); browser_inventory is the named consumer still to migrate. The open then silently uses the prefix path and reports success.
classification_rationale: the path forms advertise opening the requested path; an embedded NUL opens a different one and reports it as the requested one. Classification is the recorder's derivation (the report gives none). Reporters disagreed on native severity: cpp-expert own judgement LOW (derived HIGH), unhappy-path UP-5 MEDIUM, cpp-safety INFO ('no check/use divergence', which holds only because no check exists). Not downgraded to express doubt (Absences rule).
summary: Derived HIGH (I3, E4; E6 not established). Architect adopted, folded with G-1: the same is_plain_leaf_path guard refuses a NUL byte with EINVAL in both path forms, same test. Fixed in c74919b25. Gate 8: removing the NUL check alone fails 4 assertions (the real\0junk rows, dir and file forms).

adjudication_rationale: Alex ruled on 2026-10-06 to KEEP THE PURE MOVE and track the fix in the existing issue #4836 rather than fix it in this change: the SFP-3 row mandates a verbatim move (a behaviour change is a separate review unit) and #4836 (open, P2, governance-deferred, not roadmap-parked) already tracks the quadratic scan. The ruling is the human operator's own decision, not a self-adjudication by the raising agent or by whoever built the change; the separation applied is the de-escalation rule's, for a derived-HIGH row released from the gate by linking it to an existing issue. severity_mapped stays BLOCKING; only the disposition is linked-to-#4836.
trigger: a Local State value of the form x@(x@(x@(... : each '@' re-runs skip_cfws over the whole remaining unterminated comment. Measured with the real header at -O2: 3 KB 2.5 ms, 6 KB 8.4 ms, 12 KB 24.9 ms, 24 KB 135.7 ms, 48 KB 354 ms; roughly 170 s of CPU per value at the 1 MiB kMaxLocalStateBytes ceiling is an extrapolation, not measured.
classification_rationale: a code-behaviour defect in the moved filter rather than a prose defect; no prose claim is involved, so truth-contradiction is the nearest of the three values (recorder's derivation, the report gives none)
summary: Derived HIGH (I5 base MEDIUM, raised one band by E2: an unprivileged local user controls their own Local State, which the agent reads; E4: plugin default-off, AdminOrApproval), PRE-EXISTING: skip_cfws moved byte-identically, so this change neither introduces nor worsens it. Not fixed here; tracked in existing #4836 (quadratic comment scan in looks_like_email_address) per the 2026-10-06 ruling above. Same fix covers the related tail: an unterminated comment is an under-match in a privacy filter (alice@(x is NOT redacted, match=0; documented accepted contract, pre-existing, LOW to MEDIUM). The reported --depth size_t underflow was refuted (200,000 random strings, depth never 0 at ')'). The report did not name the original reporter of the quadratic scan, so reporter is unresolved.

trigger: a future narrowing edit to agents/shared/email_redaction.hpp: the browser_inventory routed row places skip_cfws and the filter in browser_inventory_parsers.hpp and lists only agents/plugins/browser_inventory/ as loaded-by, so an edit to the shared header matches no routed trigger
classification_rationale: the row says skip_cfws() lives in browser_inventory_parsers.hpp, but it is now a lambda in agents/shared/email_redaction.hpp:69 and the parsers header holds only the two using-declarations. Reporters: security-guardian F1 MEDIUM, consistency-auditor MEDIUM, docs-writer LOW (handed the truth call to the domain agents), plugin-developer INFO. HIGH ('conceals a security-relevant behaviour') was argued and not adopted: the filter is byte-identical and test_browser_inventory_parsers.cpp:191-306 still pins it.
summary: Derived MEDIUM (I7 borderline, I9 behaviourally; E3). Architect adopted (fold, no independent surface): the browser_inventory row text and its loaded-by scope now name agents/shared/email_redaction.hpp and say skip_cfws is a local helper of looks_like_email_address in that header. Fixed in c74919b25; tests/test_issue_docs.py OK, row file within its cap (11202/40000). The README is not stale (it names symbols, not the file). The optional banner on email_redaction.hpp was not part of the adopted fix.

trigger: a consumer opens or reads a path on a dead hard network mount (NFS/FUSE) through the shared helper: the read loop is bounded by bytes, not time, and O_NONBLOCK does not help a regular file there
classification_rationale: header line 44 ('deadlines/timeouts, #4875 is host-level') is accurate but omits the consequence and the runtimes plugin's mount-table guard obligation; a missing disclosure contradicts nothing, so absence rather than truth-contradiction
summary: Derived MEDIUM, effectively LOW and disclosed (I5, E5, likely), covered by open #4875. Architect adopted: one header paragraph names the unbounded blocking on a dead hard network mount and points at #4875 for the host-level guard. Fixed in c74919b25. The report's further note that a caller-chosen huge cap gives a transient allocation of about 2x cap (no helper-side ceiling) was not separately ruled.

trigger: a reader or migration author relies on the header's divergence claims and consumer list
classification_rationale: the header's divergence 1 calls a closing-the-raw-fd-on-failure pattern a flaw while the new finish_dir_open does the same single close; its ENOTDIR claim disagrees with a sibling comment (confined_fs_posix.cpp:135-137 says ELOOP); the consumers-to-migrate and flag-divergence lists are incomplete. Epistemic status and impact are the recorder's derivation from the report's LOW label.
summary: Rejected by the Architect with evidence: the ENOTDIR claim stands (the Linux container run asserts ENOTDIR for a leaf directory symlink and passes, 110 assertions as nobody), and the divergence and consumer wording is the SFP-1 spec's own text, whose per-plugin copies' behaviour could not be verified beyond the spec. Not adopted: adding browser_policy, runtimes, certificates, update_source_trust, privacy_permissions and system_hardening to the consumer list, noting the O_CLOEXEC/O_NOCTTY divergence, and the 'replaces' wording. The report did not name the reporter, so reporter is unresolved.

trigger: the SFP-1 row acceptance 'permission-denied -> typed status' read against ReadError, which has no permission value
classification_rationale: EACCES is reported as ReadError::io with err verbatim (header errno policy, test asserts EACCES) while the row acceptance names a typed status. Spec ambiguous: happy-path found every row and manifest requirement met, consistency-auditor read it as only partly met. Impact and exposure are the recorder's derivation from the report's LOW label.
summary: Rejected by the Architect: errno is reported verbatim by design, not as a typed permission value; the ambiguity is noted for the PR body. The report's INFO aside that O_NOCTTY (commit 2e90742a4) sits outside the manifest's SFP-1 file-read flag set is behaviour-neutral and has repo precedent (system_hardening_linux.cpp:73).

trigger: a later change to the path-form guard, ScopedDir move-assign, or the other listed corners regresses with no test failing
classification_rationale: tests are absent for trailing-slash and embedded-NUL path forms (tied to G-1/G-2), ScopedDir move-assign onto a valid target and self-move, empty file and cap==0, an exactly-8192-byte file, a directory-open ELOOP link loop, a sha256 split test that never crosses a block, a non-copyable static_assert, and the read-error/fstat-failure/EINTR/bad_alloc paths (need a seam). Impact and exposure are the recorder's derivation from the report's LOW label; the report names no line.
summary: Partly adopted, partly rejected (as the dw-5 precedent). Adopted and fixed in c74919b25: trailing slash/dot and NUL rows for both path forms, a ScopedDir move-assign test and non-copyable static_asserts. Rejected by the Architect: the FIFO-hang-versus-fail point (documented O_NONBLOCK pin fails first), cap 0, exact-8192 and the sha256 split corners (correct by inspection, beyond acceptance). The remaining listed gaps (directory-open ELOOP link loop, read-error/fstat/EINTR/bad_alloc paths) have no recorded ruling. Gate 8 verified the new tests fail under mutation (guard removal 20 assertions, NUL check 4, '/' check 8, '/.' check 8, size>1 to size>=1 1, move-assign without closedir 2). The report did not name the reporter, so reporter is unresolved.

trigger: reading or compiling the three new shared headers and the changelog fragment
classification_rationale: a batch of wording, include, API-shape and minor notes from docs-writer, cpp-expert and cpp-safety; the headline item is a reference to unraised work. Impact and exposure are the recorder's derivation from the report's NICE/INFO label.
summary: Batch, partly adopted. Fixed in c74919b25: the banner no longer names remote_access_audit (it exists nowhere in the repo) and says 'Consumer today: browser_inventory'. Rejected by the Architect: include order and unused includes, and the raw-int-err result-struct shape and missing [[nodiscard]] (style; a deferred design decision for the migration PRs, no issue filed). No ruling is recorded for the other sub-items: 'replaces' vs 'will replace' and the rot-prone local_security_policy_legs.hpp line numbers in posix_secure_read.hpp, ~95-column comment lines, the changelog bullet wording, the docs-unchanged PR-body lines, the ScopedDir::fd() borrowed-handle doc line, errno-capture hardening, the two sha256_hex overloads, and the latent Sha256::hex_digest() re-entrancy (moved verbatim, pre-existing).

trigger: a migration PR hands the path forms a path that can carry a trailing '/', for example an fs::path built from a root string with a trailing separator (browser_inventory_linux_parsers.hpp:235 passes root.string()), or relies on '//' or './' being accepted
classification_rationale: the guard rejects '//' and './' (both end in '/') but accepts '.' and '..' (neither can be a symlink leaf) while the contract said only that '/' alone is allowed; the consequence for a caller holding a trailing-separator root was unstated. The gate-8 report is one agent covering security-guardian, cpp-safety and cpp-expert scope and does not attribute findings per scope, so reporter is the first-named scope.
summary: Harmless today: no production caller of the shared path forms, and every literal directory path in the current copies is slash-free at the end. Adopted as a small follow-up: the header contract now says a caller holding a root with a trailing separator must strip it first. Fixed in 23a79e484.

trigger: a Catch reporter or a future Catch change touches errno between ::fcntl(a_fd, F_GETFD) and CHECK(errno == EBADF) in the ScopedDir move-assign test
classification_rationale: the test reads errno after an intervening assertion macro, so it can observe something other than the fcntl failure; it passes today. The report names the final two CHECKs of the new ScopedDir move test, not a line. Reporter is the first-named scope of the single combined gate-8 agent.
summary: Adopted as a small follow-up: the return code and errno are captured into locals immediately after ::fcntl, then asserted. Fixed in 23a79e484.

classification_rationale: an observation, not a defect: the guard is purely lexical and the path forms still follow intermediate components, which the contract already documents; nothing here is a TOCTOU claim
summary: No action (gate-8 ruling: INFO, none): the observation confirms the documented contract that intermediate components are followed and that the guard is lexical.
